scope: Independent int-valued microbenchmark; not the unavailable original consumer harness, Unity timing, IL2CPP, or whole-workload qualification. Issue #1131 remains open.

environment.mono: Mono 6.14.1 amd64 Homebrew bottle, isolated glibc 2.39_1, Linux WSL2 6.18.54.1
environment.affinity: Default scheduling; no affinity or priority override

method.warmup: 64 repetitions of every cell before the measured pass; one extra per arm before calibration.
method.measurement: All arms calibrated to at least 25 ms; 21 rounds with rotating arm order; three independent processes per runtime. ns per entry includes loop overhead.
method.shapes: dense i, seeded Random(7329) distinct nonnegative keys, lowbits i*1024. Misses use ~key.
method.operations: construct allocates a pre-sized map and fills it each loop; insert clears and refills existing storage; iterate sums pair keys and values.
method.summary: Median of 21 raw rounds within each arm and process, then median of three process medians; ratio of those medians.
method.limitations: Each runtime uses its own OS. Do not compare absolute timings across runtimes. Construction includes allocation and GC. HashCode shim is never called by measured operations.

replay.instructions: Extract program and hashShim as .cs files outside Unity. Read baseline source at tag 3.7.1 and replace every IntMap token with BaselineIntMap. Add the candidate source identified above. Build Release net10.0 and net48 with SDK 10.0.403 and Microsoft.NETFramework.ReferenceAssemblies.net48 1.0.3. Run each binary in three fresh processes; capture stdout summaries and stderr raw samples. Use Mono 6.14.1 x64 for net48.
replay.hashShim: namespace WallstopStudios.UnityHelpers.Core.Helper { public static class Objects { public static int HashCode(params object[] values) { return 0; } } }
